artifact_scope: Stage 2 revision shard; canonical files remain untouched
revision_objective: Integrate Olive Oil & Sea Salt as the sixth product and define the strict-front/strict-side dramatic brand-mood series without unsupported claims or borrowed perfume/laboratory language.

count_wording_decision.rule: Use 'six/여섯/6' for current-lineup facts, comparison UI, proof-image roles, constraints and metadata. Use category-neutral wording for durable brand message, family USP, scalable grammar rules and moodboard headline copy.
why: Olive Oil & Sea Salt must be visible as a real sixth member wherever the present assortment is counted.
Brand-level language should not become obsolete when the assortment changes.
Category-neutral family language keeps MORA centered on ingredient behavior rather than SKU count.
count_wording_decision.approved_durable_family_copy: 같은 한 컵 구조에서, 재료마다 다른 향과 질감, 여운을 비교하는 인퓨전 그릭요거트 패밀리.
count_wording_decision.approved_short_family_copy: 한 컵의 구조, 재료마다 다른 결.
count_wording_decision.approved_current_lineup_copy: 향의 첫인상, 요거트와 만나는 질감, 마지막 여운으로 여섯 컵을 비교합니다.

positioning_revision.positioning_statement: For urban adults who want a dense snack, a small dessert or a savory accompaniment with a clear ingredient point of view, MORA is a six-recipe Greek-yogurt family designed to reveal each ingredient through aroma, texture and finish. Unlike topping-led desserts or benefit-first yogurt, it makes the yogurt body and ingredient trace the basis of choice, with claims limited to what each finished recipe can prove.
positioning_revision.promise: A legible comparison among six ingredient directions in a consistent single-serving format, now spanning herbal, green, toasted, bright, deep and savory roles.
positioning_revision.range_effect: Olive Oil & Sea Salt expands MORA beyond sweet and dessert-adjacent expectations without repositioning the product as a meal replacement.
positioning_revision.proof_boundary: Savory, oil texture and salt contrast are directional sensory intentions until the finished recipe, oil behavior, emulsion stability and sensory panel are validated.

family_usp_revision.primary: 같은 한 컵 구조에서, 재료마다 다른 향과 질감, 여운을 비교하는 인퓨전 그릭요거트 패밀리.
family_usp_revision.short_form: 한 컵의 구조, 재료마다 다른 결.
family_usp_revision.current_lineup_support: 허브·그린·토스티드·브라이트·딥·세이보리, 여섯 방향을 같은 순서로 비교합니다.
family_usp_revision.validation_note: The terms '인퓨전', the sensory coordinates and any shared-density claim require recipe and process validation.

new_product.product_type: 150 g olive-oil-and-sea-salt Greek yogurt; directional savory recipe concept
new_product.lineup_role: Savory boundary-expander — gives the family a clearly non-dessert-led direction and broadens when and how a cup can be chosen.
new_product.use_case: A chilled savory afternoon cup, optionally served beside plain crackers or cut vegetables; it is not positioned or described as a meal replacement.
new_product.differentiator: A directional contrast between the rounded texture associated with olive oil and a short sea-salt finish, subject to recipe and sensory validation.
new_product.product_usp: 올리브 오일의 둥근 질감과 바다소금의 짧은 대비로, 단맛 중심이 아닌 세이보리 선택지를 여는 한 컵.
new_product.landing_message: 올리브 오일의 둥근 결, 바다소금의 짧은 끝.

proof_image_roles.brief: Show the same open-cup angle and spoon cut as the family; depict a pale olive-gold ribbon or sheen only if the prototype shows it naturally.
Show the actual interface between yogurt and oil at spoon-cut scale; do not exaggerate gloss or imply cosmetic cream.
Place one cup beside one plain cracker or a small amount of cut vegetable as an optional pairing; avoid a full meal spread.
Keep cup, exposure, camera height and spoon state identical; distinguish the savory product through verified food texture, not decorative olive-green styling.

factual_boundaries: Do not identify the oil grade, cultivar, harvest, origin or production method without supplier documentation.
Do not state sodium, salt level, mineral content, nutrition, health or satiety benefits without approved data.
Do not imply the product replaces a meal.
Do not show visible oil ribbon, crystals or emulsion behavior unless a finished prototype supports the depiction.
Olive and salt ingredient declarations, allergens, serving instructions, storage and shelf life remain pending.

message_to_visual_map_revision.brand_mood_to_message: The paired mood frames support 차분한 정확성 by proving that a dramatic change can come from camera direction and composition while the person, action and food remain constant.

strict_axis_brand_mood_series.verbal_premise: 같은 사람이 같은 재료를 같은 순간에 다룹니다. 정면에서는 동작의 구조를, 측면에서는 힘의 방향을 봅니다.
strict_axis_brand_mood_series.communication_job: Create dramatic brand authorship through controlled viewpoint change while preserving the truth of one food-making action.

front_frame.label: STRICT FRONT
front_frame.headline: 정면에서, 동작의 구조가 드러납니다.
front_frame.caption: 사람과 그릇, 손과 재료가 한 축 위에 놓입니다.
front_frame.composition_job: Use frontal symmetry, direct gaze of the body axis and a clear vertical/horizontal arrangement to make the action feel deliberate.

side_frame.label: STRICT SIDE
side_frame.headline: 측면에서, 같은 동작의 방향이 선명해집니다.
side_frame.caption: 흐름과 손의 거리, 그릇으로 이어지는 힘을 옆에서 봅니다.
side_frame.composition_job: Use exact profile, directional negative space and the action vector to reveal motion and force.

strict_axis_brand_mood_series.pair_caption: 같은 제작자, 같은 재료, 같은 동작. 카메라 축만 바뀝니다.
fixed_invariants: Same maker identity, wardrobe and body scale
Same food action at the same phase
Same ingredient, vessel, utensil, work surface and background
Same lighting direction, exposure family, color treatment and retouching
Same crop family and subject scale
Same factual caption about the action
strict_axis_brand_mood_series.only_controlled_change: Camera axis changes from true 0-degree front to exact 90-degree side; framing compensates only enough to preserve subject scale and the action phase.
drama_sources: A strong but food-legible directional key light
Clear silhouette separation of hands, vessel and ingredient
Tight control of horizon, verticals and crop
Preserved yogurt texture and ingredient detail
sentence_behavior: Use parallel sentence construction across the pair.
Name viewpoint and visible action, not atmosphere or mystique.
Keep each headline to one clause and each caption to one observable relationship.
Use the same verified action noun in both captions so the camera-axis change is the only narrative variable.
rejection_tests: Maker, action phase, prop set, lighting or styling changes between frames, making the pair read as two shoots.
The front frame is three-quarter rather than strict front, or the side frame is not exact profile.
Drama comes from dark perfume-advertising color, haze, grain, amber glass or laboratory props.
Headlines romanticize craft instead of describing viewpoint and action.
Directional light destroys the white-yogurt texture or makes food color inaccurate.
